_comment: Deployment config for the client preview, added 18 Aug 2026.
No build step. This is hand-written static HTML and CSS, and the only
dependencies in package.json are the checker and the two asset tools,
none of which run on the server. installCommand and buildCommand are
empty so Vercel serves the repository as-is instead of downloading
Playwright and sharp on every deploy.
The rewrite exists because the page lives two levels down at
'New Builds/buyer/', which makes an awkward URL to send a client.
Serving it at the root works because the page's asset paths are all
'../../assets/...', and browsers clamp '..' at the root, so they still
REMOVE THE X-Robots-Tag BEFORE LAUNCH. While this is a proof of
concept the page carries bracketed placeholders such as [Suburb], an
unverified availability count, and award and review figures nobody has
checked yet. None of that should be indexed against the client's brand.
Vercel noindexes preview URLs on its own, but this header also covers
the production URL, which is the one that would otherwise get crawled.
